### Vocabulary in scope

New at this step:
- bearer — it is necessary that each bearer bears at least 1 individual quantity (HCP L1 — Jargon: bearer, the object a property is about; L1 indexes by the whole oscillator. Sorted (sortOf): an object type whose objects know their sort)
- nominal name (also: designation) — it is necessary that each nominal name names exactly one object (HCP L1 — Designated (designation, designation_inj): distinct nominal names)
- individual quantity (also: IndividualQuantity) — it is necessary that each individual quantity is about exactly one bearer (HCP L1 — IndividualQuantity: a magnitude of kind k about one object o)
- same-bearer arithmetic — it is necessary that each same-bearer arithmetic is about exactly one bearer (HCP L1 — IndividualQuantity.add, IndividualQuantity.div: same-object, kind-licensed arithmetic)
- difference law — it is necessary that each difference law compares exactly one kind of property (HCP L1 — DifferenceKind.ofScale: licenses comparing two records of one quantity)
- squared angular frequency (also: angular frequency squared, omegaSquaredK) — the quantity kind `squared angular frequency` (ratio scale), adopted from PhysLibKinds
- SortOfSystem — another name for *sort of system*, carried from PKC
- Sorted (also: Designated) — another name for *object*, carried from PKC
- massK — another name for *mass*, carried from L0
- springConstantK — another name for *spring constant*, carried from L0
- *object* is named by *nominal name* — verb
- *nominal name* names *object* — verb
- *individual quantity* is about *bearer* — verb
- *bearer* bears *individual quantity* — verb
- *difference law* compares *kind of property* — verb

Carried from earlier steps:
- L0: quantity, dimensioned kind, oscillator, body, spring, wall, oscillator mass, oscillator stiffness, mass, spring constant, angular frequency, frequency
- PKC: system context, sort of system, kind of property, dimension, object
- Foundation: artifact, system, model, requirement, check, finding, evidence, persona, step
